question: According to Global Multidimensional poverty index (2022), On the basis of four indicators- nutrition, cooking fuel, sanitation and housing, how much poor people live in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**34.4 million**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (**GMMPI**) 2022 uses ten indicators across three dimensions: health, education, and living standards to measure poverty.
 
• In India, **36.1**% of the population lives below the multidimensional poverty line.
 
• This means that nearly 361 million Indians are deprived of at least one of the ten indicators.
 
• The most common deprivations are in nutrition, sanitation, and housing.
